test_layout: 12 tests per task; tests 1-6 = visible pool, tests 7-12 = fixed hidden set; every test is labelled hard; visible tests are not shown when runner uses k=0.
notes: Pure-Python deterministic network/data-handling tasks. Every test is labelled hard by design. Expected values were generated by local reference implementations and the artifact was checked for schema integrity. This file has NOT yet been independently double-implemented for every test or run against target LLMs; the intended <50% first-attempt task pass rate is an empirical target, not a verified result. This format follows the supplied runner contract of 12 tests per task; no reference_solution field is included.

tasks.title: Strict HTTP chunked-transfer decoder
tasks.prompt: Implement the HTTP/1.1 chunked body decoder described by RFC 9112. Return decoded body bytes as lowercase hex and parsed trailers. Raise ValueError for malformed framing.

tasks.title: HTTP/1.x request-head parser
tasks.prompt: Parse an HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 request message from its wire bytes (RFC 9112). Return request-line fields, normalized header pairs, and the remaining body as hex. Raise ValueError for malformed syntax.

tasks.title: HTTP message framing resolution
tasks.prompt: Resolve HTTP message-body framing from header pairs under RFC 9112. Return none, content-length:N, or chunked. Raise ValueError for ambiguous or unsupported framing.

tasks.title: Strict URI percent-decoding
tasks.prompt: Decode a URI component’s percent escapes as UTF-8 following RFC 3986. A plus sign is a literal plus. Reject malformed escapes and invalid UTF-8 with ValueError.

tasks.title: Canonical URI query serialization
tasks.prompt: Canonicalize an RFC 3986 query by decoding keys and values as UTF-8, re-encoding with uppercase percent escapes, and sorting encoded pairs. Preserve duplicates; a key without equals has an empty value.

tasks.title: Canonical strict Base64 decoder
tasks.prompt: Decode standard Base64 as specified by RFC 4648 and return the bytes as lowercase hex. Reject non-canonical encodings, invalid alphabet characters, and incorrect padding with ValueError.

tasks.title: UTF-8 decoding across transport chunks
tasks.prompt: Decode hex-encoded transport chunks as one strict UTF-8 stream. Chunk boundaries may split a character. Raise ValueError on invalid or truncated sequences.

tasks.title: DNS compressed-name decoder
tasks.signature: def parse_dns_name(packet_hex: str, offset: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Decode a DNS wire-format domain name at a packet offset, including compression pointers (RFC 1035). Return [name, next_offset]. Raise ValueError for invalid pointers, loops, truncated labels, or invalid lengths.

tasks.title: DNS wire-name encoder
tasks.prompt: Encode a textual DNS name into its wire-format label sequence (RFC 1035), returning lowercase hex. Raise ValueError when the name cannot fit the DNS wire-name format.

tasks.title: Canonical IPv6 address formatter
tasks.prompt: Return the canonical compressed lowercase textual form of an IPv6 address following RFC 5952 conventions. Reject prefixes, brackets, and zone identifiers.

tasks.title: Minimal IPv4 CIDR range summarization
tasks.signature: def summarize_ipv4_range(start: str, end: str) -> list
tasks.prompt: Return the minimal ordered set of IPv4 CIDR blocks exactly covering an inclusive address range. Raise ValueError for invalid addresses or a reversed range.

tasks.title: IPv4 longest-prefix route lookup
tasks.signature: def longest_prefix(ip: str, routes: list) -> str
tasks.prompt: Select the next hop for an IPv4 destination using longest-prefix matching over CIDR routes. Return null when no route matches. Invalid route entries raise ValueError.

tasks.title: RFC 1071 Internet checksum
tasks.prompt: Compute the 16-bit one’s-complement Internet checksum over hex bytes in network byte order (RFC 1071). Return four lowercase hex digits.

tasks.title: HTTP header canonicalization with duplicate fields
tasks.prompt: Normalize HTTP field names and optional whitespace, combine repeated fields in encounter order, then sort by lowercase name. Reject invalid field names or control characters.

tasks.title: Strict Cache-Control directive parser
tasks.prompt: Parse an HTTP Cache-Control field into a lowercase-keyed directive map while respecting quoted strings and escapes. Raise ValueError for malformed syntax or duplicate directives.

tasks.title: HTTP byte-range resolution
tasks.signature: def parse_byte_ranges(header: str, size: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Resolve an HTTP bytes range field against a representation size. Return sorted, merged, inclusive [start,end] ranges; ignore syntactically valid unsatisfiable ranges and reject malformed syntax.

tasks.title: Strict RFC 4180-style CSV record parser
tasks.prompt: Parse one strict CSV record, including doubled quote escaping and an optional final CRLF (RFC 4180). Raise ValueError for malformed quoting or embedded line breaks.

tasks.title: Strict UTF-8 netstring stream decoder
tasks.prompt: Decode a concatenated stream of UTF-8 netstrings in length:payload, format. Raise ValueError for non-canonical lengths, truncation, missing delimiters, or invalid UTF-8.

tasks.title: Canonical Protocol Buffers wire scanner
tasks.prompt: Scan a Protocol Buffers wire-format message and return [field_number, wire_type, value] entries in encounter order. Values are integers for varints and lowercase hex for fixed-width or length-delimited data. Reject malformed/non-canonical varints and unsupported wire types.

tasks.title: Strict canonical JSON serializer
tasks.prompt: Parse JSON and return deterministic compact serialization with object keys sorted lexicographically and Unicode preserved. Reject duplicate keys, non-standard constants, and malformed JSON.
